newsitem.title: USA: DMG hires Lise Buyer as Internet analyst.
newsitem.headline: DMG hires Lise Buyer as Internet analyst.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said on Wednesday that Lise Buyer will join its DMG Technology Group as a director and technology research analyst covering the Internet and new media companies.

Buyer, who will be based in the firm's Menlo Park offices starting in August, has been a research analyst and portfolio manager at T. Rowe Price in Baltimore, where she has covered Internet, new media and PC related companies since 1992.
Buyer joins DMG following the departure of Internet analyst Bill Gurley, announced earlier this week, to become a partner at Hummer Winblad Venture Partners.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell is the investment banking arm of Deutsche Bank Group. ((sam.perry@reuters.com, Palo Alto Bureau 415 846 5400))
